Friess Associates Increases Holding in Pixelworks (PXLW); Apple (AAPL) Holder Palisade Asset Management Has Decreased Its Stake
May 17, 2018 - By Clifton Ray
Palisade Asset Management Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 3.17% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Palisade Asset Management Llc sold 2,746 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 83,753 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $14.17B, down from 86,499 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Palisade Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $920.51 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.48% or $0.9 during the last trading session, reaching $187.28. About 10.41M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Friess Associates Llc increased its stake in Pixelworks Inc. (PXLW) by 26.5% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC.
